frontmatter.description: AVIA (Algorithm Visualizer & Interactive Assistant) — an offline-first, dark tech-noir IDE and precision instrument workspace for visualising 13 canonical CS algorithms in lockstep with four-language source code, interactive practice, and an offline AI tutor. Repo/module/package names remain `AlgoLens`; the user-facing product name is AVIA.
